customer_question: There's a yellow warning mark on Design Details in the Submission Requirements section of our Review Page -- is this a problem we need to fix before Submission?
question_variants: Does the Design Details warning mean something is wrong with our registration?
Can we proceed to Submission despite this warning mark?
Why does this warning appear when our registration doesn't include a Host layer?
actual_issue: A yellow warning mark appeared on Design Details within the Submission Requirements section of the Review Page, and it needed to be clarified whether this indicated a problem requiring correction or was simply an expected notice given the registration's scope.
plain_english_explanation: Not every warning icon on a registration review screen means something is actually wrong -- some are just informational flags about the kind of registration you're doing. Here, the warning simply reflected that this particular registration doesn't include a software/host layer, which is normal for this kind of registration and doesn't need to be fixed before submitting.
consultant_answer: The yellow warning mark shown on Design Details in the Submission Requirements is simply an alert that this registration does not include a Host layer -- it is not an actual problem, and the registration is accepted as-is if Submission proceeds.
decision_logic: A yellow warning mark on Design Details that reflects only the registration's lack of a Host layer is an informational notice, not a blocking issue, and does not require correction before Submission.
final_recommendation: When a Design Details warning mark appears for a registration that intentionally does not include a Host layer (such as a Controller-only or Component-only registration), confirm with the customer that this is expected and proceed to Submission without treating it as a defect.
risk_if_done_wrong: Treating this informational warning as a defect requiring correction could cause unnecessary delay or rework on a registration that is otherwise ready to submit.
